title: Greyhawk for 1e FRPG
description: The World of Greyhawk (1983 Guide and Glossography) and Greyhawk Adventures for 1e FRPG (Table Edition): deity clerics on the character sheet, a Greyhawk tab, the books as clean text, spells, magic items, monsters, avatars, personalities, encounter and birthplace tables, and the Flanaess maps. An optional add-on; turn it on or off in Manage Modules. Built for a private table.
